corrective_spec: Supply exact feet, both sole/contact landmarks, both hand grips, shaft/tool attachment, cup floor-contact, source rectangle, duration and native destination for every pose.

Do not stretch, squash, frame-scale, dissolve, or translate the entire hero to conceal cup drift. Keep shaft length and cup shape materially consistent.

Preserve Easy pacifier; express exertion through brows, cheeks, posture and arms rather than requiring visible gritted teeth.
Match the final release to the existing emerged pipe at action elapsed 1.0 and the current gameplay costume; do not replace the registered pipe shape.
